paragraphs.body: LiveScore reports that Antonio Conte (referred to as Gasperini in source text) warned Roma fans about the goal-hungry nature of the team ahead of a European clash against the injured Red Devils. Soccer News adds that Gasperini stated Roma felt they had dropped two points in their recent draw with Napoli. Conversely, Yahoo Sports cites Allegri as being enraged after the 3-3 draw with Roma, suggesting he might not be on the touchline. Football Italia notes that Gasperini believes scoring many goals is a positive signal, while Udinese's Runjaic claimed Roma exploited every mistake. CBS Sports highlights Francesco Totti's 2002 volley against Udinese as a memorable Roma masterpiece.

headline: Roma faces scrutiny as Gasperini warns fans, while Allegri expresses fury over 3-3 draw with Napoli.
